description: Diagnostic-only module to investigate why write_service shows stale heartbeat (8h30m old) while service is responsive. Must: (1) query service_health for write_service last_heartbeat timestamp, (2) verify POST to write_service/write still works, (3) check if write_service has a self-heartbeat mechanism that may be broken, (4) do NOT propose rebuild of write_service (protected). Output diagnosis to stdout and return suggested fix action (e.g., restart command, config change). Service name: diagnose_writeservice_heartbeat.
